summary.name: Together AI
summary.one_liner: Together AI is a full-stack AI cloud platform for running open-source models via inference APIs, fine-tuning them, and renting GPU infrastructure.
use_cases: Running open-source LLMs via an API without managing infrastructure
Renting GPU clusters for AI training or inference
Hosting video, audio, and image generation models
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Together AI as a platform spanning experimentation to large-scale production. Its offerings include serverless inference for open-source models, asynchronous batch processing (stated to scale to 30 billion tokens per model), and committed inference capacity with reserved throughput and a 99% uptime SLA. It also offers dedicated model deployments, GPU infrastructure (from self-serve instant clusters to thousands of GPUs), and GPU infrastructure for generative media models. Additional products include code sandboxes for AI app and agent development, managed object storage and parallel filesystems with zero egress fees, and fine-tuning of open-source models.
notable: Drop-in API compatibility for production workloads
Zero egress fees on managed storage
Together Kernel Collection for GPU performance optimization
caveats: Committed capacity and dedicated deployments are described as options for teams with higher needs; specific prices are not listed on the page
Listing tags the tool as freemium, but the page itself does not state free-tier details
